title: Signia Hilton Introduces ‘Signia Restore,’ Setting a New Standard for Elevated Fitness and Wellness in Hospitality
summary: Signia Hilton announced Signia Restore, a new integrated wellness concept that reimagines how travelers train, recover and recharge.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


Debuting in Indianapolis, the immersive new concept blends advanced fitness, restorative technologies and elevated design to help guests perform at their best


**MCLEAN, Va. and INDIANAPOLIS -**[Signia Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/signia-by-hilton) , a portfolio of world-class hotels in gateway cities and resort destinations, today announced Signia Restore, a new integrated wellness concept that reimagines how travelers train, recover and recharge while away from home.


Debuting at Signia Hilton Indianapolis, which is accepting reservations for January 2027, Signia Restore combines high-performance fitness, advanced recovery experiences, personalized wellness guidance and curated retail offerings to help guests feel restored.


Signia Restore Recovery Zone Rendering - Credit: Rottet Studio


Designed for today’s modern traveler, Signia Restore offers flexible, highly-personalized wellness experiences customized to individual schedules and goals. Whether maintaining a fitness routine between meetings, recovering from a long day of travel or preparing for an evening out, guests can tailor their experience with offerings designed to support relaxation, recovery and overall well-being.


“At Hilton, we see wellness as an increasingly important part of how guests want to travel, whether they are on the road for business, attending a major event or simply looking to feel their best while away from home,” said Amanda Al-Masri, vice president, wellness, Hilton. “With Signia Restore, we are expanding that vision through an experience that brings together movement, recovery and personalization in a way that feels elevated, approachable and highly relevant to today’s traveler. It reflects our broader commitment to making wellness more intentional, integrated and meaningful across the guest journey.”


Signia Restore Physical Recovery & Reset Zone Rendering - Credit: Rottet Studio


## A Personalized Wellness Experience


Signia Restore is organized around three integrated experiences — **recovery, fitness, and retail** — allowing guests to create a wellness journey tailored to their individual needs and leaving travelers feeling sharper, stronger and fully restored, all guided by a dedicated wellness concierge.


## Recovery Reimagined


At the heart of Signia Restore are dedicated recovery environments, featuring next-generation wellness technologies designed to support physical renewal and enhance mental clarity. The experience is centered around two distinct zones:


Physical Recovery & Reset Zone


Mental Recovery & Readiness Zone


Designed to restore vitality and accelerate recovery after training or travel, this zone features an Infrared Halotherapy Red Light Sauna, Hybrid Sauna, Sensory Showers and a Cold Therapy Room.


Focused on relaxation, recovery and focus, this area includes Zero G MindSync Harmonic Loungers, Normatec Air Compression and Percussive Therapy to help guests feel refreshed, centered and ready for what’s next.


Signia Hilton Indianapolis will also introduce a collection of advanced wellness innovations, including **Aescape** , an intelligent recovery system using physical AI and robotics to deliver precision bodywork personalized to every guest, and the **Ammortal Chamber** , a breakthrough, multi-modal service that integrates red and near-infrared light therapy, pulsed electrostatic fields, vibroacoustics, molecular hydrogen and guided breathwork.


## Fitness Designed for Performance


Guests will have access to a sleek, high-performance training environment equipped with precision strength and cardio equipment, including Peloton® Bikes, premium treadmills, rowing and conditioning equipment, as well as expansive free-weight and functional training zones. Every element is designed to help travelers maintain strength, focus and routine while on the road.


Entrance to Signia Restore Rendering - Credit: Rottet Studio


## Curated Wellness Essentials


A thoughtfully curated wellness retail experience will offer functional nutrition, hydration solutions, restorative wellness products and premium athleisure, providing guests with easy access to products that support performance, recovery and daily well-being while traveling.


Following its debut in Indianapolis, Signia Restore is expected to expand to select Signia Hilton properties globally, reinforcing the brand’s commitment to delivering sophisticated wellness experiences. In addition to individual sessions, Signia Restore will offer private group buyouts designed for executive retreats, leadership summits, incentive programs and team gatherings.


To book an upcoming stay at Signia Hilton Indianapolis, visit[Hilton.com](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/inddisa-signia-indianapolis) . To learn more about Signia Hilton, visit[stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/brands/signia-by-hilton) .


##### FAQ: Signia Restore


Signia Restore is a new signature recovery concept from Signia Hilton that reimagines the role of wellness during travel. The immersive offering introduces an advanced collection of technologies to reduce stress, boost energy and accelerate recovery while away from home.


Signia Restore will launch at Signia Hilton Indianapolis, which is accepting reservations for **January 2027** . The concept is expected to expand to select Signia Hilton properties globally over time.


Signia Restore features a state-of-the-art fitness center, dedicated recovery zones with advanced wellness technologies, personalized guidance from a wellness concierge and a curated retail shop offering wellness essentials, functional nutrition and athleisure wear. Experiences include infrared and hybrid saunas, cold therapy, sensory showers, robotic massage offerings and other recovery technologies.


Signia Restore is designed for both hotel guests and locals. Experiences will be available to enjoy individually or reserved for private groups, making the concept ideal for executive retreats, leadership summits, incentive programs and other group gatherings.


Rather than offering standalone fitness or spa amenities, Signia Restore integrates fitness, recovery and wellness technologies into one cohesive experience. Guests can move between strength training, recovery therapies and guided wellness experiences based on their individual needs and schedules.


The concept will launch first at Signia Hilton Indianapolis and is expected to expand to select Signia Hilton hotels in the future.
